event_ledger_sample.description: Established Stripe Connect Instant Payouts SLA guaranteeing sub-30-minute settlement across North American and European connected accounts.
User stated that the Automated Marketplace Split-Settlement Engine depends on the Stripe Connect Instant Payouts SLA remaining under 30 minutes without manual treasury prefunding.
Established that the Q3 Guaranteed Same-Day Creator Payout Tier depends directly on the Automated Marketplace Split-Settlement Engine operating without manual prefunding.
Cancelled Project Mercury (self-serve iOS/Android mobile SDK) to focus engineering 100% on SOC-2 Type II
Exit-interview audit contradicted the SAML SSO churn hypothesis, revealing 9 of 11 churned mid-market accounts left due to webhook retry tail latency exceeding 12 seconds.
Priya Nair transitioned from Founding Designer to Head of Product.
Tomas Lindqvist transitioned from Support Lead to Enterprise Solutions Architect.
Retired obsolete Redis 6 in favor of Valkey 8 for the production cache.
Stripe deprecated the sub-30-minute cross-border Instant Payouts SLA, setting settlement time to T+2 business days for EU accounts.
Cut paid acquisition spend from $65,000/month to $18,000/month.
Switched from pure usage pricing to Hybrid Platform Pricing model ($299/month base + $0.002/event overage) due to unpredictable bills.
Restarted Project Mercury for the flagship retail pilot.
